description: Rb₂NaSbBr₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Rb is bonded to twelve equivalent Br atoms to form RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SbBr₆ octahedra. All Rb-Br bond lengths are 4.05 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SbBr₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.92 Å. Sb is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form SbBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sb-Br bond lengths are 2.81 Å. Br is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Sb atom.
